subject: MATHS
name: Areas Related to Circles
summary: The circle sliced and framed: area and circumference, the sector and arc as a fraction of the whole, the segment as sector minus triangle, and the ring left between two radii or a shape and its inscribed circle.

hi.name: वृत्तों से संबंधित क्षेत्रफल
hi.summary: वृत्त कटा और घिरा: क्षेत्रफल और परिधि, पूरे के अंश बतौर त्रिज्यखंड और चाप, त्रिज्यखंड घटा त्रिभुज बतौर वृत्तखंड, और दो त्रिज्याओं या आकृति और उसके अंतर्वृत्त के बीच बचा वलय।

questions.stem: The area of a circle is 154 cm². What is its radius in cm? (Take π = 22/7.)
questions.solution: Area = πr² = 154, so r² = 154·7/22 = 49 and r = √49 = 7 cm. (49 is r², before the square root.)

hi.stem: एक वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल 154 सेमी² है। इसकी त्रिज्या सेमी में क्या है? (π = 22/7 लें।)
hi.solution: क्षेत्रफल = πr² = 154, अतः r² = 154·7/22 = 49 और r = √49 = 7 सेमी। (49 वर्गमूल से पहले r²।)

mr.stem: एका वर्तुळाचे क्षेत्रफळ 154 सेमी² आहे. त्याची त्रिज्या सेमीमध्ये काय? (π = 22/7 घ्या.)
mr.solution: क्षेत्रफळ = πr² = 154, म्हणून r² = 154·7/22 = 49 आणि r = √49 = 7 सेमी. (49 वर्गमूळापूर्वी r².)

questions.stem: What is the circumference of a circle of radius 35 cm? (Take π = 22/7.)
questions.solution: Circumference = 2πr = 2·(22/7)·35 = 2·22·35/7 = 220 cm. (1225 is r², used for area.)

questions.stem: What is the area of a circle of radius 14 cm? (Take π = 22/7.)
questions.solution: Area = πr² = (22/7)·14² = 22·196/7 = 616 cm². (88 is the circumference.)

questions.stem: What is the perimeter of a semicircle of radius 7 cm? (Take π = 22/7.)
questions.solution: Perimeter = half the circumference + the diameter = πr + 2r = (22/7)·7 + 14 = 22 + 14 = 36 cm.

questions.stem: A circle is inscribed in a square of side 14 cm. What is the area, in cm², left between the square and the circle? (Take π = 22/7.)
questions.solution: The circle's radius is 7 cm. Area left = square − circle = 14² − (22/7)·49 = 196 − 154 = 42 cm².

hi.stem: 14 सेमी भुजा के वर्ग में एक वृत्त अंतर्निहित है। वर्ग और वृत्त के बीच बचा क्षेत्रफल सेमी² में क्या है? (π = 22/7 लें।)

questions.stem: The minute hand of a clock is 7 cm long. What area, in cm², does it sweep in 15 minutes? (Take π = 22/7.)
questions.solution: 15 minutes is a quarter turn, so area = (1/4)·πr² = (1/4)·(22/7)·49 = 154/4 = 38.5 cm².

hi.stem: एक घड़ी की मिनट की सुई 7 सेमी लंबी है। यह 15 मिनट में कितना क्षेत्रफल सेमी² में बुहारती है? (π = 22/7 लें।)

questions.stem: Two circles have radii 8 cm and 6 cm. A single circle has area equal to the sum of their areas. What is its radius?
questions.solution: π R² = π·8² + π·6², so R² = 64 + 36 = 100 and R = √100 = 10 cm. (14 wrongly adds the radii.)

questions.stem: A chord of a circle of radius 14 cm subtends a right angle (90°) at the centre. What is the area, in cm², of the corresponding minor segment? (Take π = 22/7.)
questions.solution: Segment = sector − triangle. Sector (90°) = (1/4)(22/7)(196) = 154; right triangle = (1/2)·14·14 = 98. So segment = 154 − 98 = 56 cm².

hi.stem: 14 सेमी त्रिज्या के वृत्त की एक जीवा केंद्र पर समकोण (90°) अंतरित करती है। संगत लघु वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल सेमी² में क्या है? (π = 22/7 लें।)

questions.stem: A horse is tied to a corner of a square field of side 15 m with a rope 7 m long. What area, in m², can it graze? (Take π = 22/7.)
questions.solution: At a 90° corner the horse grazes a quarter circle of radius 7 m: (1/4)·(22/7)·49 = 154/4 = 38.5 m².
